data.name: Crewin: The Wrath Of Athys
data.detailed_description:
About Crewin: The Wrath Of Athys

Immerse yourself in the mystical lands of Crewin, a realm where legends come alive, in this enthralling Fantasy RPG. "Crewin: The Wrath Of Athys" invites you on an epic journey filled with peril and intrigue. As a humble inhabitant of Black Hollow, you are thrust into a monumental quest against the malevolent cult, The Flaming Eye. Their dark mission? To commandeer the elemental dragons and unleash Athys, the goddess of Chaos and Destruction, plunging the world into a millennia of unending darkness.

Long before your journey begins, the elemental dragons stood as guardians of balance across Crewin — bound to the land, the sky, and the deep places beneath the earth. The Flaming Eye seeks to shatter that balance, corrupting each dragon in turn to feed Athys's return. What starts as a personal reckoning for a lone villager of Black Hollow grows into a struggle for the fate of the entire realm. Are you ready to forge your legacy and thwart their sinister plot?

Key Features

  • Souls-Inspired Combat System: Engage in a challenging and rewarding combat experience reminiscent of the Souls series. Master an arsenal of weapons, learn the art of directional rolling, perfect your parries, and execute devastating special attacks. Whether you prefer the finesse of single-handed weapons, the power of two-handed armaments, the precision of archery, or the thrill of dual-wielding, our combat system caters to every warrior's style. Every encounter demands you read your opponent, manage your stamina, and commit to the moment — victory is earned, never handed to you.

  • An Open World Worth Exploring: Crewin is no narrow corridor of scripted set pieces — it's a living, open realm to wander at your own pace. Push past the borders of Black Hollow into unfamiliar wilds, uncover hidden ruins left behind by older ages, and stumble into dangers (and rewards) that the main quest will never point you toward directly. Every path off the beaten track holds the chance of a new discovery, whether that's a forgotten shrine, a wandering merchant, or a fight you weren't ready for.

  • A Richly Woven Narrative: Delve into a world brimming with lore and adventure. "Crewin: The Wrath Of Athys" isn't just about the main storyline; it's a tapestry of tales waiting to be discovered. Embark on side quests and crucial questlines that not only complement the main narrative but also enrich your understanding of Crewin's mystical world, its people, and the forces now moving against them.

  • Innovative Save System: Our unique save system utilizes bonfires as checkpoints. Not only do they offer a respite from your arduous journey, but they also serve as a strategic tool to reset your stats and strategize your next moves — rest, regroup, and decide how you want to face what comes next.

  • Mod Support (In Development): We believe in the power of community-driven creativity. That's why we're excited to announce that mod support is in the works! Soon, you'll be able to extend your adventure and express your creativity by crafting and sharing your own modifications.

Prepare to embark on a journey through mystical landscapes, face formidable foes, and unravel the secrets of Crewin. Your odyssey awaits in "Crewin: The Wrath Of Athys."

data.short_description: A Souls-inspired open-world RPG where mastery of blade, bow, and dual steel decides your survival. Roll, parry, and strike your way across the mystical realm of Crewin to stop the cult of the Flaming Eye before they unleash Athys, goddess of chaos and destruction.
